name: Shaurya Mehta
player_statement:
A complete player, Shaurya Mehta has made a big mark in cricket. With 180 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 72*, with an average of 15.90 and a quick strike rate of 107.12. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 39 sixes and 203 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 761.3 overs, taking 169 wickets at an economy rate of 5.70. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
